BiblicalUsage: The word ṭûwʼ is the Bible's way of saying to sweep away. In Isaiah 14:23, I will sweep it with the besom of destruction.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe ṭûwʼ still tells the truth about God, and I take it as it stands.
